sn1.3:1.1: Evam antaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn1.3:2.1: Upanīyati jīvitam appam āyu || jarūpanītassa na santi tāṇā || etaṃ bhayaṃ marane pekkhamāno || puññāni kayirātha sukhāvahānī ti || ||
sn1.3:3.1: Upanīyati jīvitam appam āyu || jarūpanītassa na santi tāṇā || etaṃ bhayaṃ maraṇe pekkhamāno || lokāmisaṃ pajahe santipekkho ti || ||
